snippet.title: Shroom and Gloom | Emerging Into Early Access on September 10
snippet.description:
Dungeon-crawling, mushroom-munching, combo-busting double-deck-builder Shroom and Gloom hits Steam Early Access on September 10.

Learn more about this unique roguelike where you'll explore the depths of hand-drawn dungeons and use hundreds of cards spread across two distinct decks to unleash red-hot synergies and delicious combos on hordes of grotesque fungal foes.

Wishlist now on Steam.
